errors.text_span: dargestellt durch lila Balken mit diagonalen Strichen
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that all purple bars have diagonal stripes. In the chart, only the purple bars for the years 2024 and 2025 have a striped pattern, while the bars for 2015 through 2023 are solid.

errors.text_span: wobei der lila Balken in den Jahren 2015 bis 2020 und 2023 bis 2025 höher ist als der hellblaue Balken
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly implies that the purple bar is not higher than the blue bar in 2021 and 2022. According to the data labels on the chart, the purple bar is higher than the blue bar in every year from 2015 to 2025, including 2021 (12.80 vs 9.55) and 2022 (13.12 vs 10.52).
